outcome_analysis.explanation: The official relation is both_fail because both completed evaluations report 0/58 and `solution_passed: false`. The important process difference is not a pass/fail split: serial entered direct implementation and left several partial library modules, while parallel kept implementation behind parent preflight/spec/harness work and only triggered the Workflow tool at the terminal point. Both artifacts lacked the required `test20.mjs`, so neither attempt delivered an executable solution.
